description: The provider refused or the stream was cut. The provider's OWN WORDS travel in `what`, because they are usually the actionable part — a wrong model name says so precisely, and paraphrasing it would discard the only useful detail. The message also records whether a retry was attempted, because `not retried` is a fact the caller needs: it means the daemon judged another attempt would produce the same answer.

data.what: model: anthropic answered 404: {"type":"error","error":{"type":"not_found_error","message":"model: claude-sonnet-99"}} (not retried: the provider will answer the same way)
data.means: the provider refused the request, or the stream was cut; the daemon retried where retrying was safe and did not where a reply had already begun
